This reptilian, [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], '''[[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]]''' had green skin, purple eyes, brown, branchlike hair and resided in the [[Aleen Underworld/Legends|Underworld]] of [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]]. A notable member of this species was [[Orphne/Legends|Orphne]].
